clue.text: Order to start shooting in battle

definitions.meaning: the word a film director calls when the cameras begin to roll
fighting, as in soldiers killed in combat

explanation.definitionFit: A director's call to begin filming is this word, and it also means military combat.

clue.text: Face up, perhaps, but not to a challenge

definitions.text: Face up, perhaps, but not to a challenge

parts.words: Face up, perhaps, but not to a challenge
parts.note: lying on one's back means facing upwards, yet the phrase also means retreating rather than confronting a challenge

explanation.surface: Someone lies face up but will not face up to a challenge.
explanation.walkthrough: Lying on your back you are face up; but the same two words also mean to retreat, the opposite of facing up to a challenge.
explanation.definitionFit: Retreating from a confrontation is the idiom's sense, while literally lying back-downwards leaves the face upward.

clue.text: What one may say when being shot?

definitions.text: What one may say when being shot?

parts.words: What one may say when being shot?
parts.note: being shot here means being photographed, when people are told to say a particular word to smile

explanation.surface: A grim question about last words before execution.
explanation.definitionFit: Photographers ask subjects to say this dairy word because it shapes the mouth into a smile.

clue.text: Virginia right to get a place in tough university

indicators.note: the Virginia-and-right letters are given a place inside the word for tough

parts.note: tough means hard
VA is the abbreviation for the US state of Virginia

explanation.surface: A Virginian earns a place at a demanding university.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the famous Ivy League university in Cambridge, Massachusetts.

clue.text: A gunsmith will add it to his stock

definitions.text: A gunsmith will add it to his stock

parts.words: A gunsmith will add it to his stock
parts.note: stock reads as a shop's inventory but is the wooden butt of a gun, to which the tube is fitted

explanation.surface: A gunsmith's shop takes in new merchandise.
explanation.definitionFit: A gun's tube is fitted to its stock, the wooden butt, when a gunsmith assembles it.

clue.text: Church enveloped in rather ornate glass

indicators.note: the church abbreviation is wrapped inside the word for rather

parts.note: sooner means rather, as in I'd sooner stay

explanation.surface: A church is surrounded by fairly elaborate stained glass.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rather ornate' looks like a single phrase; 'rather' is the outer word and 'ornate glass' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a large tall drinking glass, often for sherry or beer, sometimes elaborately shaped.

clue.text: Squabble a lot? Rubbish!

parts.note: a scrap is a fight or squabble
a heap is a large amount, a lot

explanation.surface: Someone dismisses the idea that they argue a great deal.
explanation.definitionFit: A pile of discarded junk is a dump of refuse, so the word stands for rubbish.

clue.text: Guard marking time

definitions.meaning: to keep ... over or a period of sentry duty
a timepiece worn on the wrist that shows the hour

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means keep guard over, and as a noun it is a wristwatch that tells the time.

clue.text: Period when one is not well off

definitions.text: Period when one is not well off

parts.words: Period when one is not well off
parts.note: not well off reads as poor but means off work because one is not well

explanation.surface: A spell of poverty.
explanation.definitionFit: Time granted off work because of illness is exactly a period when one is unwell and away.

clue.text: It sweeps right inside the harbour bar

indicators.note: the letter for right goes inside the word for a harbour barrier

parts.note: a boom is a floating barrier across a harbour mouth

explanation.surface: Something sweeps right into a harbourside pub.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a long-handled brush used for sweeping floors.

clue.text: I'd turn in at the entrance to a mine

indicators.note: the reversed letters are placed inside the word at

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: turn tells us to read the letters of I'd backwards

explanation.surface: Someone says they would turn in at a mine entrance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn' and 'in' read like going to bed at a pit; 'turn' reverses I'd, and 'in' places that inside the word at.
explanation.definitionFit: A horizontal passage leading into a mine is the mining term for its entrance.

clue.text: What the unsatisfied audience may shout

definitions.text: What the unsatisfied audience may shout

parts.words: What the unsatisfied audience may shout
parts.note: unsatisfied suggests displeasure but means the audience has not had enough and wants more

explanation.surface: A disgruntled audience heckles.
explanation.definitionFit: Audiences shout this French word to demand a repeat performance when they want more.

clue.text: Evocative of European river ebbing fast

indicators.note: ebbing means flowing back, so the river's name is read backwards

parts.note: the Oder is a river of central Europe
Lent is the Christian period of fasting

explanation.surface: A European river ebbing quickly calls something to mind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fast' looks like an adverb for the ebbing, but it is the noun: the Lenten fast.
explanation.definitionFit: A scent or scene reminiscent of something is said to be suggestive or evocative of it.

clue.text: A help or hindrance in the works

definitions.text: A help or hindrance in the works

parts.words: A help or hindrance in the works
parts.note: a mechanic's tool helps in the workshop, yet throwing one in the works is the idiom for sabotage

explanation.surface: Something in a factory might assist or obstruct.
explanation.definitionFit: This tool helps engineers, and the idiom of throwing one in the works means causing obstruction.

clue.text: Encourage a single girl to be spendthrift

parts.note: to prod is to urge or encourage
I is the Roman numeral one
gal is an informal word for girl

explanation.surface: Urging a single woman to spend freely.
explanation.definitionFit: A wasteful, extravagant person, as in the parable of the son who squandered his inheritance.

clue.text: Players leave English football team before time

parts.note: XI is eleven in Roman numerals, a football side

explanation.surface: Players walk out on the England football team before the final whistle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Players' are actors here: the word is a stage direction telling performers to go off.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the stage direction for actors going off; used as a verb it means depart.

clue.text: Height of piece of sculpture is about right

indicators.note: about tells us the sculpture word goes around the right letter

parts.note: a statue is a piece of sculpture

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a statue's height is roughly correct.
explanation.definitionFit: A person's natural height, standing tall, is a synonym for bodily stature in the sense of size.

clue.text: Social occasion in Boston: tipping in the main was dutifully observed

definitions.meaning: a gathering where a hot drink and cakes are served

definitions.text: in Boston: tipping in the main was dutifully observed
definitions.meaning: the 1773 protest where colonists dumped taxed cargo into the sea over duty

explanation.definitionFit: A gathering over a cuppa is one sense; the other is the 1773 Boston protest against British import duty.

clue.text: Admire a freshly baked cake

indicators.note: something baked anew is made over, so the letters are mixed into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone praises a cake just out of the oven.
explanation.definitionFit: A plain sponge traditionally served with a glass of the Portuguese fortified wine of that name.

clue.text: Restored a man's oil painting

indicators.note: restoring means putting back together, so these letters are reassembled

parts.note: the letters including the possessive s join the pool

explanation.surface: Someone restored a man's oil painting.
explanation.definitionFit: Leonardo's famous portrait in the Louvre is the world's best-known painting.

clue.text: On a winding road it shows skill

definitions.note: a verb phrase standing for an adjective meaning skilful

indicators.note: a winding road twists, so the letters are twisted into a new order

explanation.surface: A driver on a twisting road demonstrates skill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'winding' rearranges ROAD to ADRO; 'On a' merely links the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: An adjective for being nimble and dexterous, so describing one who displays skill.

clue.text: City boom precedes tax cut

parts.note: a boom is a spar on a ship

indicators.note: cut means the last letter of tax is removed

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A city's economic boom comes before a tax reduction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boom' suggests economic growth but is the nautical spar.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient Greek city-state famous for its warriors.

clue.text: Quiet during day without a lot of noise

parts.note: sh is a call for quiet
in means during

indicators.note: without tells us to remove the letter from day

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Quiet by day, with none of the usual racket.
explanation.definitionFit: An informal word for a noisy disturbance or uproar.

clue.text: They hold an alternative view of things

indicators.note: the word they holds the alternative word inside it

parts.note: taken as written
or introduces an alternative

explanation.surface: Some people hold a different opinion.
explanation.definitionFit: A considered idea explaining how things are is a conceptual view of the world.

clue.text: Nobody's daily account

parts.note: recalls the comic novel by the Grossmith brothers about Mr Pooter's journal

explanation.surface: No one keeps a daily record.
explanation.walkthrough: The Diary of a Nobody is a classic 1892 British comic novel, the journal of the pompous clerk Charles Pooter.
explanation.definitionFit: A daily written record kept by someone, as in the famous comic book about a nobody.

clue.text: Thinks the current recession splits friends

indicators.note: the reversed current divides the word for friends in two

parts.note: mates are friends

indicators.note: receding means going backwards, so the current's word is read in reverse

parts.note: a tide is a current

explanation.surface: Someone muses that the economic downturn is dividing friends.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recession' looks economic, but it signals the current word going backwards, and 'splits' puts the result between the first and second letters of the friends word.
explanation.definitionFit: To ponder or contemplate deeply is to engage in reflective thought.

clue.text: Send message to a daughter in port

indicators.note: the letters for a daughter are placed inside the port

parts.note: Rio de Janeiro is a Brazilian port

explanation.surface: Someone sends word to a daughter in a harbour town.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means transmit by wireless, sending a message over the airwaves.

clue.text: Falsely portrayed as being rapacious

indicators.note: falsely means wrongly, so the letters are set out in a wrong order

explanation.surface: Someone is wrongly depicted as greedy.
explanation.definitionFit: Greedy and grasping, living by plunder like a hunting animal.
